cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Over dinner you keep saying you're managing. What's hard about going home?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The silence. I leave the television on so it sounds occupied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Could you ask me over instead of pretending you've got company?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook. I promise I won't be miserable all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you invite me without that promise? I'd like to come even if you're miserable and we eat toast.

mechanism: A corrects its pupil hosting rules to make a lonely friend invite real company without promising cheerful performance.
confusable: Not an offer to be entertained: A explicitly accepts sadness and minimal food.
comparison: Workplace cheerful facade versus private competent-host facade.
seedUse: D108 silence/television/cooking/toast; S05 hosting skill becomes permission to stop proving.
